basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical professional with software delivery, project management, systems integration, and client-support experience. Background includes leading a platform upgrade, gathering implementation requirements, coordinating development and client work, and communicating delivery updates. Combines hands-on development experience with operational process improvements and customer-facing documentation.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, coordinating development projects and supporting client implementations.
highlights: Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening tax-provider and financial-platform support and improving UI/UX.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, including Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients and updated invoices for inventory changes to help maintain accurate records.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.

education.area: Industrial Engineering and Supply Chain/Operations Management

coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Product Owner position at Direct Supply. My background combines software delivery, systems integration, project coordination, and client support, with experience serving as technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform. The role’s emphasis on clarifying development work, collaborating with technical teams, and representing customer needs connects closely with that experience. I would bring a practical understanding of both implementation challenges and the communication needed to move technical work forward.

At DSTax Technologies, I managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests. I also supported implementations from requirements gathering and setup through troubleshooting and go-live. Leading the platform’s transition from Version 1 to Version 2 involved broadening financial-platform and tax-provider support while improving UI/UX. This experience provides a foundation for working with developers and stakeholders to clarify needs and coordinate delivery. A second example comes from Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), where I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers. I also initiated web automations that reduced manual database maintenance and designed SharePoint data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and support information sharing across departments. These efforts connected operational needs with practical technology improvements, a useful perspective for assessing product value and improving work processes.

The opportunity at Direct Supply brings this delivery work into healthcare technology serving seniors and those who care for them. The position offers a clear connection between customer needs, development decisions, and useful product outcomes. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my platform development, implementation, and stakeholder communication experience could support your product team. Thank you for considering my application.
Sincerely, Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasizes software delivery, requirements gathering, platform upgrades, stakeholder communication, and process automation. Prioritizes Agile, Jira & Confluence, and listed AI tools. The master does not establish direct backlog ownership, user-story or acceptance-criteria writing, sprint tracking, AI-assisted product workflows, healthcare experience, or CSPO certification.
